trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. Follow the five-stage roadmap in order: finish the story, clear every contact strand before the finale, sweep collectibles and activities, then wrap up 100% completion. Nothing here is gated beyond the count trophies in stages 3 and 4.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the Gone Fishing story mission to its end. It unlocks naturally as you work through the early story; keep following the mission markers and do not skip the fishing sequence, since the trophy pops when the mission completes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Play every main mission in order until the chapter-closing mission ends; the trophy pops at the chapter card.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: follow the main-mission markers through the chapter until the closing mission completes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the main missions in order; the trophy lands when the chapter's final mission is done.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Work through the chapter's main missions until the closing one completes; the trophy pops at the chapter card.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Reach the end of the story and play the finale to its conclusion; the trophy pops when the credits roll. Finish the contact strands first — several of their trophies close at the finale.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Follow the story markers to the mission, play it through, and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — work through its setup and execution beats in order; the trophy lands when the heist mission completes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission. Follow the mission markers, play the mission through to its end, and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. Work through the mission's beats in order and the trophy lands when it completes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Head to the airport area when the marker appears, play the takedown through, and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Follow the story markers into the operation, play it through to the end, and the trophy lands when the mission completes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Clear every item the game counts toward completion — story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles — then check the in-game stats page to see what is left. This is usually the last trophy earned before the platinum, so sweep the count trophies first and let this one follow.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, long airtime, near misses and drifts all feed the counter; the in-game stats page tracks your total. Chain stunt jumps on the highways and around the airport runways — a fast bike and a ramp make the count climb quickly.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once. Sample one of each: a race, a shooting-range challenge, fishing, an arcade game, a drone race, and anything else the map offers. The trophy pops the moment you have touched each type at least once.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. Visit the range, learn each weapon's recoil pattern, and work through the challenges one by one. Take your time on the timed lanes — steady aimed shots beat sprayed ones.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone-race spot on the map, win the race there, and move to the next. Learn the gates on your first run, then push for the win on the second.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across Leonida — street, off-road and water — and win a different event each time. Replays of a race you already won do not add to the count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots, take his challenge, and out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel in when the fish runs, and keep the line from snapping.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet, and play a full game to its end. Any cabinet counts.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand. Complete every mission Andy gives you, and do the last one before the finale — his strand closes when the story ends. Check the map for his marker between story missions so you do not leave him for last.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand. Play all of Kenton's missions in order and complete his final one before the finale, or the strand locks and the trophy is gone for this playthrough.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand. Clear Billy's missions as they appear and finish his last one before the end of the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Pick up stranger missions as you find them on the map and finish eight full strands. Start early and keep at them between story missions — strands can close at the finale.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand. Complete Randy's missions in order and wrap his final mission up before the finale.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand. Same pattern as the other contacts: all of Tyrone's missions, final one before the story ends.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find each meditation spot — quiet overlooks, beaches and parks — and sit through the full meditation at each one. The map fills in as you discover them.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal to its territory, and bring it down. Do it before the finale, since his strand closes with the story.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards scattered around Leonida — shops, interiors and hidden corners — and finish any three full sets. Cards stay collected, so sweep a district at a time.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are marked around the map; visit each one and interact. Work district by district and the count climbs steadily.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The challenge list covers combat, driving, exploration and more — open it from the pause menu, pick the quick ones first, and let the total build as you play.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get the heat to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Alleys, tunnels and the water help you vanish.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner along, and keep the wanted stars from appearing — move fast, stay quiet, and pick shops close together.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything new you see — cars, bikes, boats, planes — and the counter ticks up the first time you get behind the wheel of each model. Car meets and parking lots are rich hunting grounds.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Build up Combat Focus, trigger it in a busy firefight, and drop five enemies before it runs out. Pick a mission with clustered enemies so the targets come to you.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport, find a plane on the tarmac, and take off without a flight plan. Expect security to object — be quick off the runway.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get inside a Rhino tank and stir up trouble — the trophy is about the moment, so find a tank at a military site, climb in, and make your presence known.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, wait for a quiet moment, slip in, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A quiet approach and a fast exit are the whole trick.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault job, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives. Five successful escapes earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. Quiet roads outside the city give you the most room to work.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, sail and fly into every corner of the map until the fog lifts everywhere. The in-game map shows which regions you have not visited yet.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs its own illegal operation somewhere in Leonida — find them all, hit each one, and get out clean.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. A small quiet moment — easy to walk past if you never stop.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get a car inside a showroom, then drive it straight out through the glass. Pick a showroom with a wide front and a fast car.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley, play a frame, and follow through on the lane. A one-off moment at a specific place.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a story moment with your partner — play the story and it will come up. It cannot be repeated once the moment passes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A story choice with consequences — make the call when it arrives and live with it. The trophy pops once the choice is locked in.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail, then try again — this trophy is for the second attempt landing where the first did not. Keep playing after a failed attempt and the moment will come.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange one-off event somewhere in Leonida. Wander the odd corners of the map — the desert, the swamps, the back roads — and it finds you.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Line up pedestrians near the bowling alley area and knock them down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. One clean pass is enough.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Rob banks and vaults to collect Marked Bills, then launder them through your contacts — the clean cash counts toward the $250,000 total.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, car upgrades and properties — every dollar spent in a shop counts toward the total. Big-ticket items like cars move the number fastest.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market across Leonida. Save up — the last ones are not cheap — and check the property listings as they unlock.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone, register ten different vehicles you own, and the trophy pops. Any ten vehicles count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophy list
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 and 2
roadmap.note: Follow the main missions in order. Pick up the early story trophies as they come and keep an eye out for Andy's marker between missions.

roadmap.title: Chapters 3 and 4, plus the contact strands
roadmap.note: Finish the remaining chapters and clear every contact strand — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — before the finale locks them.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.note: Work through the races, the shooting range, the stunts and the one-off feats. Partner trophies and the airport moments belong here, while your partner is still around.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, money and exploration
roadmap.note: Sweep the cards and WAiNK spots district by district, explore every corner of Leonida, and spend and launder your way through the money trophies.

roadmap.title: Finale and the platinum
roadmap.note: Play the final mission, then mop up 100% completion. The platinum pops the moment the last requirement falls.
